question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Cash runs well ahead of reported income, and the gap widened against the company's own history. Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2024. The ratio rose because trailing net income fell {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} while operating cash flow rose {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct} to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}. In the quarter itself the company reported a net loss of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} while operating cash flow was {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, up {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} on the year-ago quarter and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the prior quarter. The wedge is non-cash and acquisition-driven: share-based compensation over the trailing four quarters was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, larger than trailing net income, and depreciation and amortization was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}; the quarter alone carried share-based compensation of {note_tables.tables.notes_175.facts.20}, up {note_tables.tables.notes_175.changes.10} on the year-ago quarter, intangible amortization of {note_tables.tables.notes_107.facts.12} and severance of {note_tables.tables.notes_83.facts.29}, while a non-cash gain of {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.8} on the QRadar contingent consideration inside general and administrative expense lifted the operating result. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, negative as in every filled year of the history ({trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} in fiscal 2025, {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} in fiscal 2024), so cash has long exceeded income; the denominator is now swollen by acquired goodwill. Working capital: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} year over year, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income} times trailing net income, while the cash-flow statement's receivables line over the same span shows an increase of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}; the articulation gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} is close to the {note_tables.tables.notes_77.facts.3} of receivables CyberArk brought on at the acquisition date, so the two statements articulate once acquired balances are allowed for. Payables supplied {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} on the balance sheet against {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change} on the cash-flow statement, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}; inventory is not tagged at either balance date, so its absorption cannot be read. Earnings are much smoother than cash: the smoothness ratio is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, well below one, because quarterly operating cash flow swings with seasonal billings while income was steady until this quarter's loss. Simple free cash flow over the trailing four quarters is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}; after share-based compensation and acquisition spending of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.inputs.acquisitions.cash_spent}, quality-adjusted free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. Share count also moved: basic weighted-average shares rose by {note_tables.tables.notes_182.changes.2} to {note_tables.tables.notes_182.facts.4} on the shares issued for CyberArk, net of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} of repurchases.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Operating cash generation is real and above income, but reported income is depressed by acquisition charges and cash is flattered by non-cash compensation that is a genuine cost; after compensation and acquisition spending the company consumed cash over the trailing four quarters.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are outrunning revenue. Quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} days, the highest of the six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in the year-ago quarter; receivables over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, also the highest, and on a trailing-four-quarter basis days sales outstanding is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. Part of the rise is acquired: CyberArk brought {note_tables.tables.notes_77.facts.3} of receivables, close to the whole articulation gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}, but the year-over-year pattern was already seasonal and the quarter-end level is still above every earlier quarter. Current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, the lowest of six quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a year earlier, even though CyberArk added {note_tables.tables.notes_77.facts.7} of deferred revenue; deferred revenue is growing more slowly than recognized revenue, so less of the growth is pre-funded by customers than a year ago. Revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the prior quarter, with product revenue up {note_tables.tables.notes_30.changes.0} and subscription and support up {note_tables.tables.notes_30.changes.6}, but the filing states the acquired businesses contributed "revenue of $388 million and $391 million" since their acquisition dates, so organic growth is well below the headline. A new judgment area appeared: product revenue now includes "certain identity security offerings" recognized when the license is delivered, a point-in-time stream that management says will vary from quarter to quarter with renewal timing, and the pro forma table puts combined revenue for the quarter at {note_tables.tables.notes_95.facts.0}. The geographic discussion credits sales-force investment alone, with United States revenue up {note_tables.tables.notes_28.changes.0}, while other paragraphs credit acquisitions, so the stated reasons for growth are not consistent across the filing. No extended payment terms, bill-and-hold or fourth-quarter concentration could be found in the inputs, and fiscal fourth quarters are not reported as durations in the record, so quarter-weighting cannot be tested. The company's own customer-financing book declined to {note_tables.tables.notes_54.facts.6} current and {note_tables.tables.notes_54.facts.14} noncurrent.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Revenue recognition is strained at the edges rather than broken: receivables and deferred revenue both move against revenue in the quarter, headline growth is partly bought, and a new point-in-time license stream widens management's discretion over quarterly timing.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The bad-debt allowance thinned while receivables peaked. The allowance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} against receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables}, a ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}, the lowest of the six filled quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} a year earlier, when the allowance was {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance}; the filing now prints to whole millions so the step is coarse, but the move is against rising receivables and acquired balances, and no explanation is given. Allowances on financing receivables were unchanged at {note_tables.tables.notes_54.facts.4} current and {note_tables.tables.notes_54.facts.12} noncurrent while the weakest internal rating bucket grew by {note_tables.tables.notes_56.changes.14} to {note_tables.tables.notes_56.facts.29} as the gross book shrank by {note_tables.tables.notes_56.changes.19}. The largest estimate change raised income: management cut its estimate of QRadar contingent payments, producing a gain of {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.8} inside general and administrative expense in a quarter with an operating loss of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter}; the level-three liability fell from {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.0} to {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.16} after payments of {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.12}, and the nine-month gain is {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.10}, while the undiscounted range the filing gives still runs well above the carrying amount. Goodwill is {note_tables.tables.notes_102.facts.2} after {note_tables.tables.notes_102.facts.1} was acquired in the nine months, intangibles are {note_tables.tables.notes_105.facts.38}, and the measurement period is open, so allocations can still move; platform-renewal intangibles of {note_tables.tables.notes_79.facts.1} carry lives of twelve to fourteen years, a long life that keeps amortization lower than a shorter one would. Tax moved against the company rather than for it: trailing tax expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income} is an effective rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, above statutory, and the quarter booked tax expense on a pretax loss; no valuation-allowance release appears and the California allowance remains. Deferred tax liabilities rose with acquired intangibles while deferred tax assets edged down. Own-share-price marks now flow through earnings under the fair value option on the assumed convertible notes, a loss of {note_tables.tables.notes_187.facts.8} for the nine months, and on capped calls carried at {note_tables.tables.notes_37.facts.67}. The Centripetal litigation accrual grows with interest. Inventory and warranty reserves are not tagged in any period, so management's statement that inventory excess and obsolete charges fell cannot be tested.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Reserves moved in the income-raising direction, a thinner bad-debt allowance and a contingent-consideration cut booked as an operating gain, while tax moved against the company; the acquisition estimates are large, open and management-set, and two reserve ratios the industry lens needs are untagged.

cost_deferral.finding: No capitalized software development cost is tagged in any period, so the capitalized-to-expensed ratio cannot be formed; research and development is expensed, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} over the trailing four quarters, and the quarter's expense rose on acquired headcount. Capitalized contract costs are mixed, current up and noncurrent down, roughly flat in total. Soft assets jumped: the soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the highest of six quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} at the fiscal year-end, because goodwill and intangibles from CyberArk and Koi now dominate the balance sheet of {terms.balances_now.assets}. The deferred cost that matters is acquired intangibles: gross intangibles rose {note_tables.tables.notes_105.changes.18}, amortization in the quarter was {note_tables.tables.notes_107.facts.12} against {note_tables.tables.notes_107.facts.13} a year earlier, and {note_tables.tables.notes_109.facts.2} is scheduled for the next twelve months with {note_tables.tables.notes_109.facts.6} beyond year four; that amortization, now inside cost of product revenue for the first time at {note_tables.tables.notes_107.facts.0}, is why gross margin fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin}, the lowest of six quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin} a year earlier. Items presented as acquisition-specific recur: transaction costs, accelerated vesting, severance of {note_tables.tables.notes_83.facts.28} and amortization appear with each deal, and the deals are serial, with acquisition cash of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions} over the trailing four quarters against {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.prior_fiscal_year} in fiscal 2025 and Portkey closing after the quarter. The non-GAAP to GAAP gap cannot be measured from the filings, since no non-GAAP concept is tagged and the release body is absent, yet performance awards are tied to non-GAAP earnings per share, which gives management a reason to define the gap generously. Capital spending rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}, including land for the headquarters, so free cash flow carries a heavier property charge than before.
cost_deferral.verdict: Cost deferral through development capitalization is not visible, but the balance sheet is now mostly purchased intangibles whose amortization is compressing margins, and the acquisition charges the company treats as one-off arrive every period.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: No receivables factoring programme or supplier-finance obligation is tagged in any period, and the calculator marks both as missing, though the financing-receivables note records sales of financing receivables whose amounts the readers did not carry, so that channel is unresolved rather than clean. Classification does move cash: payments on the QRadar contingent consideration, {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.14} in the nine months and {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.12} in the quarter, are presented in financing activities, so a cash cost of buying that business sits outside operating cash flow and outside the company's own free cash flow measure; gains on investments sold to fund acquisitions sit in earnings while the proceeds sit in investing, with the other, net line at {note_tables.tables.notes_187.facts.17} for the nine months against {note_tables.tables.notes_187.facts.18} a year earlier; and the {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued.parts.this_year_to_date} received for terminating part of the capped calls is tagged as proceeds from convertible debt. Unrecorded purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier; {note_tables.tables.notes_142.facts.0} of the total is cloud commitments, of which {note_tables.tables.notes_142.facts.6} falls due beyond four years, and the whole is well above trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. Leases grew with the headquarters extension; the calculator's invested capital still carries an operating lease liability of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability} from the prior fiscal year-end and flags that the period-end noncurrent balance alone is larger. The company assumed convertible notes: the fair value table shows {note_tables.tables.notes_37.facts.91} short-term and {note_tables.tables.notes_37.facts.123} long-term, yet the calculator's total debt is {ratios.solvency.total_debt} and net debt {ratios.solvency.net_debt} because its tag list omits convertible debt, so leverage and invested-capital figures here understate the obligations; interest expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense} because the notes carry no coupon, and their principal is settleable in cash. No guarantee exposure or variable-interest entity is tagged. Share-based compensation is treated as the real cost it is: {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters and {note_tables.tables.notes_175.facts.20} in the quarter against {note_tables.tables.notes_175.facts.21} a year earlier, which is why quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} is negative while simple free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: No factoring or supplier finance is visible, but financing-classified acquisition payments, investment gains in earnings, a doubled commitment book and debt the calculator cannot see all make operating cash flow and leverage look better than the economics.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: No auditor's report sits in a 10-Q bundle, so auditor changes and critical audit matters cannot be read here. The controls item says no change in internal control over financial reporting materially affected it during the quarter in which CyberArk, acquired for {note_tables.tables.notes_75.facts.4}, and Koi were consolidated; it neither reports bringing the acquired companies into the control assessment nor excluding them, and no material weakness is disclosed. No chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller departure appears in the inputs, and no late filing or amendment appears. The earnings release filed as an 8-K is listed but its body is absent, and the index contradicts itself about whether it is on record, so the release cannot be matched to the 10-Q. An 8-K dated 2026-04-13 reporting a material agreement and a direct financial obligation also has no body, and the debt note describes only the credit agreement from calendar 2023 with nothing drawn, so which agreement that filing reports is unresolved. Presentation changed quietly: facts from fiscal 2026 filings are rounded to whole millions where earlier periods printed tenths, which coarsens small balances such as the bad-debt allowance and makes its fall look stepwise; prior-year totals are re-presented in the current report and no restatement trace exists in the bundle to say whether any value moved. The pro forma table combines the company's quarters with CyberArk's calendar quarters ended a month earlier, the earnings-per-share captions now read net income (loss), and the filing reserves discretion over how much acquisition impact it will disclose for the coming year. No related-party growth, subsidiary-list change or comment letter appears in the inputs.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: No hard control failure is on record, but the control assertion is silent on the largest acquisition in the company's history, the earnings release cannot be checked against the 10-Q, and presentation choices (rounding, misaligned pro forma periods, disclosure discretion) reduce what an outside reader can verify.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Of the forty-six notes items that carry a direction, most are confirmed by the numbers: the acquisition entries (consideration, goodwill, intangibles, replacement awards, severance, amortization, transaction costs), the assumed convertible notes and capped calls, the lease extension, the repurchases, the quarter's operating loss and the margin compression all print in the direction the prose gives. Two cross-checks tie exactly: the prose's subscription-and-support amortization increase matches {note_tables.tables.notes_107.changes.2} for the quarter and {note_tables.tables.notes_107.changes.3} for the nine months in the amortization table, and the prose's contingent-consideration gain matches {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.8} in the level-three rollforward. Two items are contradicted. Deferred tax liabilities rose rather than fell despite the deductible-goodwill prose, carrying the {note_tables.tables.notes_77.facts.8} CyberArk brought in. Management's attribution of higher operating cash flow to increased collections is not supported by the receivables data: quarter-end receivables stand at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} days of quarterly revenue, the highest of six quarters, and the cash-flow statement's receivables line reads {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables.parts.this_year_to_date} for this fiscal year to date against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables.parts.prior_year_to_date} a year earlier, a smaller release of cash from receivables than last year even though operating cash flow itself rose. Several items are unresolved because they fall after the balance-sheet date (the Portkey closing, the cash settlement of the surrendered notes) or because the account is not tagged (inventory excess and obsolete charges, QRadar-migrated revenue, the principal conversion that has not happened). The 8-K earnings release cannot be matched to the 10-Q because its body is not in the bundle; the numbers reader found no earnings-release figures to check.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The notes and the numbers largely agree on what happened; where they disagree it is on management's explanation of cash flow and on the tax effect of acquired goodwill, and the earnings release remains unchecked.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: inventory is not tagged at the quarter-end and no inventory reserve or write-down is tagged in any period, so neither days of inventory nor a reserve ratio can be formed for the quarter; the fiscal 2025 annual figure was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} days against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} the year before, management says excess and obsolete charges fell, which cannot be tested, and the filing names memory and component shortages and tariffs as pressures on hardware cost. Purchase commitments: unrecorded obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, up from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, with cloud commitments of {note_tables.tables.notes_142.facts.0} and inventory commitments of {note_tables.tables.notes_142.facts.7}; the cloud figure alone is well above trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}, and while whether it exceeds need cannot be judged from the filings, its growth far outpaces trailing revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Customer concentration: the latest tagged facts, from the fiscal 2025 10-K, put four distributors at {concentration.facts.0|pct} of accounts receivable and three customers at {concentration.facts.1|pct}, {concentration.facts.2|pct} and {concentration.facts.3|pct} of revenue; the 10-Q tables carry no update, so the acquisition's effect on concentration is unknown. Channel stuffing: the signals that would accompany it are present, days sales outstanding at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of six quarters, receivables over revenue at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, the allowance at its lowest, product revenue up {note_tables.tables.notes_30.changes.0} on hardware demand and licenses, and distributors as the largest customers, but acquired receivables of {note_tables.tables.notes_77.facts.3} explain most of the articulation gap and nothing in the prose addresses channel inventory, so the reading stays open rather than adverse. Circular or vendor-financed deals: the company finances its own customers through financing receivables of {note_tables.tables.notes_54.facts.6} current and {note_tables.tables.notes_54.facts.14} noncurrent, a book that shrank by {note_tables.tables.notes_56.changes.19} gross while its weakest rating bucket rose to {note_tables.tables.notes_56.facts.29}; some of these receivables are sold, with amounts not carried into the inputs. The QRadar arrangement pays IBM only when its customers sign qualified new transactions, and the estimate cut signals fewer such migrations than planned. No investment in a customer that then buys from the company appears in the inputs.
industry_lens.verdict: The hardware-specific tests are mostly untestable because inventory and its reserve are untagged; the visible industry signals are a receivables peak with a thin allowance against distributor customers, a cloud commitment book growing far faster than revenue, and a shrinking but weakening customer-financing book.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로 fiscal 2025의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배보다 높아졌는데, 인수 관련 비현금 비용으로 이익은 줄고 현금은 늘었기 때문입니다. 다만 주식보상비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}과 인수대금을 빼면 질 조정 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}로 마이너스입니다.

summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금 비율은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮은데 매출채권은 가장 많습니다. QRadar 조건부 대가 추정치를 낮춰 {note_tables.tables.notes_42.facts.8}의 이익이 판관비 안에서 인식되었고, 영업권은 {note_tables.tables.notes_102.facts.2}로 총자산 {terms.balances_now.assets}의 큰 부분을 차지하며 배분은 아직 확정되지 않았습니다.
